description: This file defines the RefreshToken class, which represents a refresh token grant in an OAuth2 client library. It extends an abstract class and provides specific implementations for obtaining the grant name and required request parameters.

classes.name: RefreshToken
classes.description: Represents a refresh token grant, extending the AbstractGrant class. It provides the grant name ('refresh_token') and required request parameters ('refresh_token').

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the grant, which is 'refresh_token'.

methods.name: getRequiredRequestParameters
methods.description: Returns an array containing 'refresh_token' as the required request parameter for this grant.
